headline: Ramayana Day 13: ₹28.35 Cr India nett
lede: Wednesday, 18 November 2026. Live estimate on the Indian Box Office desk (sacnilk), board updated 05:53 pm IST. Day 13 India nett is ₹28.35 Cr against Day 12 ₹32.00 Cr (-11.4%). Desk cumulative India nett is ₹849.3 Cr and worldwide gross is ₹1,483.1 Cr through Day 13.
body:
20:00 IST desk report. The day's collection so far. This day is still moving, so the daily figure is a live estimate and is not the final drop.

## Day 13 — latest reported collection

Status: live estimate. Source on the board: sacnilk. Updated: 05:53 pm IST. Shows tracked: 22,551. Occupancy: 22.9%.

India nett: ₹28.35 Cr (live estimate).

India gross: ₹33.85 Cr (live estimate).

Change against Day 12: previous day ₹32.00 Cr nett, current day ₹28.35 Cr nett, change -11.4%.

Day 13 worldwide gross is not on the row, so the lifetime worldwide figure is not moved forward for this day.
